story.title: Chacarra earns third win of year to move top of Race to Dubai standings
story.summary: Eugenio Chacarra won the DP World India Championship by two shots with the Spaniard's third victory of the season moving him top of the Race to Dubai standings, above Patrick Reed and Rory McIlroy, with three events remaining.
